name: zakaria-auto-group-enterprise
description: Zakaria Auto Group LLC — Enterprise Dealership Web Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @zakaria/api" "npm run dev -w @zakaria/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @zakaria/api && npm run build -w @zakaria/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run start -w @zakaria/api" "npm run start -w @zakaria/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @zakaria/api && npm run lint -w @zakaria/web
